prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Write final class Solution in Solution.java with the static method shown; java.util types may be imported.
Required API: public static List<Integer> rollingChecksums(List<Integer> values, int window)
Behavior: For every complete window, emit the position-weighted checksum sum((offset+1)*value). Reject a zero window (and negative where representable). A window longer than input returns a non-null empty result; do not mutate input.
Visible example: values [2,4,1,3] with window 3 return [13,15].

Buggy source to repair:

import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<Integer> rollingChecksums(List<Integer>values,int window){if(window<=0)return null;var out=new ArrayList<Integer>();for(int i=0;i+window<=values.size();i++){int sum=0;for(int j=i;j<i+window;j++)sum+=values.get(j);out.add(sum);}return out;}}
